result.description:
IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super

ABOUT KILCOY GLOBAL FOODS

We are the largest grain fed beef producers in Australia, located in Kilcoy, one and a half hours north-west of Brisbane CBD. Our large workforce consists of 1700 staff and our people are the backbone of our business providing dedication and hard work to ensure the smooth running of our operations. At Kilcoy Global Foods we provide our staff with a great place to work which includes job security, quality safety standards, lifestyle shifts and the ability to progress within the organisation.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Job Title: Meat Quality Assurance Officer

Company Name: Kilcoy Pastoral Company Limited

Location: 4830 D'Aguilar Highway, Winya Queensland 4515. 

Employment Type: Permanent.

REMUNERATION: $40-41 per hour

 

We are seeking an experienced Meat Quality Assurance Officer to join our team and ensure the consistent delivery of quality products to KGF customers. The successful candidates will support the operational teams by assisting the business achieve its operational and strategic goals through monitoring effective QA practices identifying and providing corrective and preventative actions as required. Key responsibilities include, but not limited to:

Ensure operations conform to food safety regulations and Quality Systems requirements though partnering with Production 
Document control and report on the non-conformance and Corrective Action Requirements (CAR's) within the parameters of the Quality Management System
Support and implement key food safety requirements and quality outcomes
Undertake quality internal audits, HACCP enquiries, and respond to any customer complaints
Ensure all staff are aware and comply with the necessary requirements of our Quality Management Systems
 

ROSTER

Working Green/Gold roster that allows a great work/life balance with both day and afternoon shifts available. 

 

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications in HACCP, and AusMeat Specification Qualifications, or
Quality assurance background in a food manufacturing environment, or
Operational experience in a meat processing facility
A strong sense of accountability and responsibility
Commitment to company values, and food safety culture
Good computer skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office suite
Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)
Attention to detail, initiative, time management and follow through
Unlimited working rights within Australia
Ability to work alongside a diverse workforce
 

BENEFITS

Working alongside committed quality professionals, with a great culture and team environment
Secure, stable, and permanent employment
Genuine opportunities for career progression including Quality Officer in Charge positions
Skills and training in HACCP and Quality Management, as well as AusMeat certification
Experience a country change
An organisation where cultural diversity is celebrated
Access to discounted premium meat
 

This is a long-term career opportunity, working for an enterprise business with Corporate Offices on the Sunshine Coast in Queensland.  We have recorded business growth of 20% year on year with sales in excess of $2 billion.  We are committed to building a work environment that fosters an agile plus flexible workplace and where employee wellbeing is paramount.

 

HOW TO APPLY

If you are looking to join a company that promotes innovation, is a leader in industry and champions success, then apply now.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and make every effort to select the best qualified individual for the job based on job related qualifications and experiences. Some of the information we collect via your application form and resume is “personal” information as defined by the Privacy Act. All information provided via your application form and resume is treated as confidential.

Job no: 934685

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Executive




 

Department for Health and Wellbeing - Digital Health SA

Classification: SAES ICT Specialist- Full Time - Term Contract (Temporary up to Three Years)

Overview:

The Director, Digital Solutions Clinical Information Systems ("Director") is accountable to the Director Clinical Information Systems (CIS) to establish and embed Clinical & PAS Information Systems, in line with key principles that will underpin and support successful implementation and ongoing use of digital solutions in SA Health.

The Director is responsible for implementation leadership and ongoing DHSA clinical business support for a range of business critical clinical and patient administration systems. This position will work collectively with LHNs to implement business change required to support the successful implementation, optimisation, and sustained support of digital solutions across South Australian Health public hospitals through agreed service level agreements which align with broader strategic and business objectives.

The Director will participate as a key stakeholder in developing strategies and optimisation approaches of clinical and PAS solutions across SA Health public hospitals to ensure clinical and administrative solutions are fit for purpose and part of an integrated network of patient care tools.

Working in partnership with Office of Chief Medical Information Officer (OCMIO), DHW, LHNs and vendors the Director is responsible for the delivery of Clinical and PAS system enhancements and optimisation.

The Director will leverage critical success factors to drive and support strong clinical and business engagement throughout all stages of system implementation. This includes workflow design, content development, education and training, and ongoing system optimisation to ensure the effective adoption and continuous improvement of digital solutions.

The Director may be required to represent DHSA on national and state level committees dealing with national and state electronic patient care systems initiatives, implementation of national health systems, future trends, and related matters.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. 

Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 934685

Criminal History Screening Requirement

. A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment)

Immunisation Risk for this position is Category C (minimal patient contact)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Special Conditions

A university qualification in medicine, nursing, allied health or other related discipline is required for this position.

result.description:
Recruitment Consultant
We understand that recruitment is a career that demands much of us and, whilst returns can be high, maximum ROI is necessary for individuals in order to realise the vision they have created for their personal lives. The rising cost of Sydney living only makes that more important.

Our consistent profitability, and the sustainability created through our recent M&A activities enable us to invest in growth without requiring instant results. We want to evolve EBC to a significant executive recruitment brand across Asia Pac – as part of that, we will hire additional talent and build brands around those people to ensure our future.

Simply put our agile, entrepreneurial, high on care/low on micro environment allows ambitious people to come and learn how to set up their own business. With our brand, environment and peer group we believe you’ll find a place that’s not just hard to leave but easy to stay.

Whilst average recruitment experience across the floor sits at 8 years per person, we aren’t fixed on that experience level, in fact, we are very open to talking with you if you’re relatively new to the game but can demonstrate proven recruitment billings success and you’re on the right trajectory.

The areas we are looking to grow include:
Accounting and Finance 
IT Infrastructure & Security
IT Data and Analytics
IT Development
IT Sales
Risk, compliance & Legal
Projects and Transformation
If you specialise in any of the above areas and like what you’ve read so far, we’d love to hear from you.

Ethos BeathChapman are one of the leading Executive Recruitment brands in Asia Pacific with presence in Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong and Japan, for more on us, visit www.ethosbc.com.au 

For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Andrew Keayes on 02 8227 9200 or apply directly via the Apply for this job button. Only WORD FORMAT resumes will be accepted.
